title: The Ball in the Well
lines: Bill has a red ball and a tall hill.
He rolls the ball off the top.
"Dad! The ball fell in!" yells Bill.
Dad gets a net, and Bill dips it in.
Bill tugs and tugs and gets the ball!
The ball is a mess. Bill gets a tub.
"Fill it! The ball can dip in," said Bill.

questions.listenFor: In a well. It is stated in the story - if they guess, have them find the line with the word well in it.

questions.ask: Who tugs the ball out of the well?
questions.listenFor: Bill does. Dad fetches the net and Bill dips and tugs. Lines five and six say it. Follow up with "and how did Dad know to come?"

questions.ask: Why do you think Bill wants a tub of water at the end? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any reason tied to the story works - "the ball is a mess" shows they connected the ending back to the well.
